about: hxq fmt of one program per host kind (class, macro class expression, abstract, enum abstract, interface, typedef, enum), each holding the construct families that host can carry (member blanks, metadata line ends, wraps, brace policy, comment runs and an else-closing `;`), under three configs: this repo's hxformat.json (repo/), a copy of a sibling library's hxformat.json kept as a fixture (sibling/), and the default `{}` (default/). Every output compiles. An interface and an enum have no statement bodies and a typedef or enum no brace policy: those families are omitted there.

invocations.note: hxq fmt of a program holding an arrow-lambda return and a return switch under whitespace.returnSemicolon never: both `;` are dropped and the case body keeps its own; the output compiles

invocations.name: condmodifier/C.hx
invocations.note: hxq fmt under lineEnds.metadata* fit of a lone metadata before a conditional modifier region: the negated compound `!(sys || js)` takes its own line, the nested-parenthesised `((sys))` rides the metadata's line; the output compiles

invocations.name: metarun/S.hx
invocations.note: hxq fmt under lineEnds.metadata* fit with metadataInlineMaxLength 20 of a call-bearing metadata followed by nine short ones wider together than the line: the call-bearing one stands alone, the short ones go one per line within the width and the last keeps the declaration's line; the output compiles
